rows.text: halves `rdx` into a wide-character count and returns 0x80070057 when that count is 0 or above 0x7FFFFFFF; otherwise copies words from `r8` to `rcx` until a zero word, the count running out, or 0x7FFFFFFE copied characters, then writes a zero word at the stop point and returns 0, except that when the count runs out the zero word overwrites the last copied word and 0x8007007A is returned

calls `00159420(rcx)`; unless `rcx` is non-null and that result is null, calls `008C2368(result, 0, edx AND 0xFFFFE0F7)` and keeps its return; always passes the `00159420` result to `008C21F8`, and returns the `008C2368` result, or 0 when it was not called

when dword `02EAEBC0` is 0, stores 0x11C, 6 and 1 into dwords `02EAEBC0`/`02EAEBC4`/`02EAEBC8` and 0 into word `02EAECD4`, calls `008C2378(02EAEBC0, 0x23, mask)` with the mask chained through three `008C2380` calls (`edx` 2, 1, 0x20, each with `r8b` 3) and stores (result == 0) into dword `01F41FA8`; returns 1 when `01F41FA8` is non-zero; otherwise, for non-null `rcx`, gets a length from `008C2370(rcx, 0, 0, 0)`, allocates `008C2348(0x40, length * 2)` and fills it with `008C2370(rcx, length, buffer, 0)`, giving up unless that second result is below the length; then for the ids 0x24, 0x26 and 0x2A in turn calls `00159B10(id, 01CB0954)` and returns 1 at the first string for which `00861FCE(buffer, string, string length)` is 0, else 0 (also 0 for null `rcx`, a 0 length, a failed allocation or a null `00159B10` result), freeing the strings and the buffer through `008C21F8`

returns 0 for null `rcx`; otherwise walks the wide string `rcx` back from its end to the first `\` (0x5C) or `.` (0x2E) and, when that is a `.`, measures the suffix from it: a suffix longer than one character returns `00159E60(rcx)`, the `.` alone returns `00159EF0(rcx, length - 1)`, and no suffix allocates `008C2348(0x40, (length + length of 01CC6BF8) * 2 + 2)`, copies `rcx` into it with `001597E0` and appends `01CC6BF8` with `001599D0`, returning the buffer, or 0 when the allocation fails or either call returns negative (the buffer then freed through `008C21F8`)

lazily fills qword `02EAEB38` with `008C2368(00159420(01CC6C68), 0, 0)` (passing the `00159420` result to `008C21F8`) and qwords `02EAEB40`/`02EAEB58` with `008C2130(02EAEB38, "RegOpenKeyExW")`/`008C2130(02EAEB38, "RegCloseKey")`, returning 0 if any stays null; calls `02EAEB40(rdx, r8, 0, 1, &handle)` and returns 0 when it is non-zero; otherwise walks the null-terminated pointer array `r9` (stride 8), reading each entry through `00159F90(handle, entry, &type, &data)` and, when that returns 0, for type 1 keeping `00159E60(data)` if `001595F0(data, rcx)` is non-zero, for type 7 keeping `00159E60` of the first string in the zero-terminated list `data` for which `001595F0(string, rcx)` is non-zero, and for any other type calling `008C2358(0xD)`; frees each `data` through `008C21F8`, stops at the first kept copy, then calls `02EAEB58(handle)` and returns the copy or 0

lazily fills qword `02EAEB38` with `008C2368(00159420(01CC6C68), 0, 0)` (passing the `00159420` result to `008C21F8`) and qwords `02EAEB40`/`02EAEB48`/`02EAEB58` with `008C2130(02EAEB38, ...)` of "RegOpenKeyExW"/"RegEnumValueW"/"RegCloseKey", returning 0 if any stays null; then for each entry of the null-terminated pointer array `r8` (stride 8) calls `02EAEB40(rdx, entry, 0, 0x20019, &handle)` and, when that returns 0, allocates `008C2348(0x40, 0x10000)` and calls `02EAEB48(handle, index, buffer, &size, 0, 0, 0, 0)` for index 0, 1, 2, ... (zeroing 0x8000 bytes with `00861EC0` and setting size to 0x7FFF before each call), keeping `00159E60(buffer)` for the first 0-returning call where `001595F0(buffer, rcx)` is non-zero and stopping at a kept copy or a 0x103 result; it then frees the buffer through `008C21F8` and calls `02EAEB58(handle)`, and returns the first kept copy, or 0 when the array runs out

calls `008C2358(0)`, and when `rcx` is null or `00159520(rcx)` is non-zero calls `008C2358(0xA0)` and returns 0; otherwise takes `0015B5F0(01CC6BE8)` and `rsi = 0015A650(rcx)` (either null skips to the cleanup) and locates the `.` suffix after the last `\` in `rsi`, then tries in order, each try only when a fresh `008C20A8()` is 0 and stopping at the first non-null result: `0015A9B0(rsi, 01CC6BE8)` when `00861F20(suffix, 01CC6BF8)` is 0; unless `00861F20(suffix, 01CC70E0)` is 0, `0015AC50(rsi, 0xFFFFFFFF80000002, the 0015B5F0 result, list 01CC7028/01CC7000/01CC6FD0)` and `0015AE60(rsi, 0xFFFFFFFF80000002, list 01CC6F90/01CC6F50)`; `0015AC50(rsi, 0xFFFFFFFF80000002, the 0015B5F0 result, list 01CC6EF0)`; and `0015B440(dir, rsi)` with `dir = 0015B110(01CC6BE8)` when `0015A240(0x37E4)` is non-zero, else `00159580()`, dropping that join when `008C2248` on it is -1 or has a bit of 0x50 set (calling `008C2358(0)` first if `008C20A8()` is 2); frees the strings through `008C21F8` and returns the result after `008C2358(0)`, or 0 after `008C2358(0x7E)` if `008C20A8()` is 0

calls `008C2358(0)`; when the wide string `rcx` contains `\` (0x5C) or `/` (0x2F) calls `008C2358(0xA0)` and returns 0; otherwise, when `0015A240(0x37E4)` is 1 and `00861FCE(rcx, 01CC70EC, length of 01CC70EC)` is 0, takes `0015B820(rcx)` and, if non-null, returns `0015B550(it, edx)` after freeing it through `008C21F8`, or returns 0 when it is null and `008C20A8()` is not 0x7E; every other path returns `00159AA0(rcx, edx)`

when qword `01F82E48` is 0, stores `008C2B40(0x20)` into it after, if non-null, setting its dword `+0x0` to 0x2000000, dword `+0x4` to 0x200000, qword `+0x10` to 0 and dword `+0x18` to 0; then tail-jumps to `008C2B60(rdx, r8)`, dropping the incoming `rcx`

notes: All 9 functions drafted; none skipped. Doubts: (1) 0015B820 is the longest row (1,078 characters) and the most complex control flow; FABLE should re-check the try order: the 0015A9B0 try runs only when the suffix matches 01CC6BF8; a 01CC70E0 match skips both the first 0015AC50 try and the 0015AE60 try; each 0015AC50/0015AE60/final try is gated by its own 008C20A8() call, and a non-zero 008C20A8() before the last try ends the chain. Also in 0015B820, the stores of 01CC70B0/01CC7088/01CC7050 at [rsp+0x20..0x30] (0015B947-0015B969) and of 01CC6F20 at [rsp+0x40] (0015BA0D) are not inside the array that r9 points at, and 0015AC50 as listed reads only rcx, rdx, r8 and the r9 array, so the row leaves them out. (2) 0015AC50's listing ends at 0015AE48 (pop r15) with the extent at 0015AE4A, so the rest of the epilogue is not shown; the row assumes the return value is rax as set at 0015AE2F/0015AD51. (3) 001597E0: the count==0 path at 0015984E is unreachable after the entry check returns 0x80070057 for a 0 count, so the row does not describe it separately. (4) 0015AE60: a non-zero 02EAEB48 result other than 0x103 keeps enumerating with the next index; the row states only the 0x103 stop. (5) 00159CA0: the comparison against the second 008C2370 result is unsigned (jbe gives up when the length is at or below it). Callees and IAT slots are named by address only; the RegOpenKeyExW/RegEnumValueW/RegCloseKey names are the strings the listings pass to 008C2130.
